experience.title: Project experience
experience.intro: A selection from more than 20 years of project work in enterprise and SME environments.

projects.title: Customer portal & ERP architecture (energy utility)
projects.description: Modernisation and maintenance of the customer and contract portal for a leading service provider in the energy sector. Focus on scalability, performance and modern REST APIs.
tasks: Refactored the tariff-change process: load time cut from 1.3 minutes to 15 seconds through fewer service requests and caching.
Rebuilt the MaLo-Ident process after the format changeover, together with three other developers, in very little time.
Replaced outdated SOAP interfaces with high-performance REST APIs.
Optimised database queries and bulk processing (CSV/cron jobs) so large data volumes run through reliably.
Ensured GDPR compliance through automated deadline checks and data deletion.
Detected errors earlier by establishing monitoring and log analysis with Graylog.
Built the dunning process as a flexible module that adapts to different rules.

projects.title: Workflow module for multi-tenancy (shipyard)
projects.description: Extraction of a complex shipbuilding-processing module from a monolith into a standalone, multi-tenant Symfony workflow module.
tasks: Made one module usable for several tenants by extending the Symfony Workflow components with tenant-specific logic.
Modelled complex process chains with pipeline patterns (event dispatcher/subscriber) to keep them extensible.
Creation of Twig extensions for dynamic sub-templates (permission and role control).
Eased handover with a technical specification and system documentation in Markdown.

projects.title: E-commerce automation & subscriptions (security software)
projects.description: Development and automation of subscription and contract-change processes within a global e-commerce customer portal.
tasks: Extension of the Sonata Admin back-end interfaces.
Implementation of automated validation for contract changes.
Creation of Twig extensions for dynamic sub-templates (permission and role control).
Quality assurance through end-to-end testing with Selenium and Cucumber/Gherkin.

projects.title: Booking funnel migration (web agency)
projects.description: Development and migration of a business-critical booking funnel from Typo3 to a high-performance, standalone Symfony application.
tasks: Coupling legacy content systems with the new booking core.
Development of dynamic pricing and booking interfaces.

projects.title: White-label travel systems (travel portals)
projects.description: Development of flexible white-label solutions for well-known travel portals for the dynamic delivery of holiday offers.
tasks: Creation of jQuery-based plugins for interactive booking elements.
Development of custom shipping and price-update modules for Magento shops.
Execution of complex platform upgrades (Magento 1.5 to 1.7).

training.title: AI Engineer – Turing College
training.description: Part-time AI Engineer programme with a final certificate: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents with LangGraph, and evaluating and securing AI systems. The result is two applications running live – deliberately built on two opposite architectural approaches.

projects.title: HikeSense – AI hiking planner
projects.description: Problem: planning a hike means collecting route, accommodation, walking time and weather from separate sites – and AI answers like to invent numbers. Approach: HikeSense plans day hikes and multi-day tours on eight long-distance trails in the Black Forest, Lake Constance and the Palatinate Forest through a chat. The code decides, the model words it: every route comes from the database, and every number is checked against the tool results. Result: 577 verified day hikes, live.
highlights: LangGraph workflow with fixed steps: guard, structured output, search, answer and grounding check.
PostGIS search with a transparent ✓/✗ check for every condition, plus near misses.
RAG knowledge index (ChromaDB + BM25) – every answer with source and licence.
Data pipeline: 4,014 OSM relations turned into 577 verified day hikes.

projects.title: CineSense – films by mood
projects.description: Problem: searching by title or genre does not help when you want a film by mood – for example “like Interstellar, but shorter”. Approach: a ReAct agent decides on its own which tools to use and in which order, the agentic counterpart to the fixed workflow of HikeSense. Result: mood-based search over film plots, live.
highlights: ReAct agent loop with LangGraph: the model plans, calls tools and evaluates intermediate results.
RAG search over film plots (search_plot) for content- and mood-based matches.
Mood tags, quick filters (cinema, streaming, no horror) and curated genre worlds.

about.title: About Alexander Liebing
about.lead: I modernise existing PHP/Symfony systems and build LLM and RAG features into running web applications.
paragraphs: My current focus is on two things: modernising grown PHP/Symfony systems and integrating AI features into existing applications. HikeSense and CineSense, both live, are the final projects of my AI Engineer programme at Turing College.

I come from the backend: since my IHK certification as an internet software developer (2001) and my apprenticeship as an IT specialist (2003) I have designed and maintained systems for EnBW (Powercloud) and Lürssen shipyard, most recently for six years as lead backend developer of a customer and contract portal.

I am open to new projects, remote or in the Karlsruhe area: additional development capacity (Symfony / Laravel), architectural advice on legacy migrations and AI features for existing applications. I work with you directly.
